Treemap of the top 100 coins

Source: R/fct_plots.R
plot_treemap.Rd

Each box is sized by market cap and colored from red to green by the 24h price change. The color limits are the 5th and 95th percentiles of the changes, so a few outliers do not wash out the rest. Coins without 24h change are labelled n/a and colored white.

Usage

plot_treemap(listings, mode = "light")

Arguments

listings

The data of get_listings().

mode

"light" (the default) or "dark", to suit a light or dark page.

Value

A plotly object.

Examples

plot_treemap(get_listings()$data)
